GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2019-11-13T23:16:06Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Drop in writes on high number of selects.
Description: Version: ClickHouse 19.13.1.11
Server has 400GB RAM with 48 CPU cores. and 3.2 TB of HDD.
Insert batch size is 20K records (~40MB). Each insert is taking ~1.5secs.
Server has 12.5B records.
We are running parallel select queries of ~500. Selects include some count queries, some aggregations and group bys.
CPU and RAM are at their minimals (like 10% of CPU and 10GB of RAM used).
During this time, inserts are dropped. Noticed "TimeoutExceptions" on client side (Using Http Client for inserts)
Get below exception at high rate. (very few select queries went through)

Code: 202, e.displayText() = DB::Exception: Too many simultaneous queries. Maximum: 100 (version 19.13.1.11 (official build))

Tried to increase max simultaneous queries in config.xml (to 1000).
 <max_concurrent_queries>1000</max_concurrent_queries>

Even after increasing, exception still says Maximun: 100
Code: 202, e.displayText() = DB::Exception: Too many simultaneous queries. Maximum: 100 (version 19.13.1.11 (official build))

Seems my change is not taking effect.

How can I make sure that writes are not impacted due to reads?
Why cant I increase simultaneous queries in spite of having RAM and MEMORY available?
How can we support more selects? (we need little higher selects to build dashboards, aggregations, and for AD purposes)

You must provide a category number (1-3). Your response must follow this format exactly:

CATEGORY: [category number]
REASONING: [your reasoning here, including specific reasons why an issue would be hard to dockerize if choosing category 3]
